notes.title: Update & Trading Cards [v23.11.21]
notes.content:
[h3]Update - v23.11.21[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] new application "Pricing manager". that application stores all items which you have in your store. Here you can easily manage your prices for all items. That app have the same functionality as you managing price for one item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/5b9e693200cdf1b41fd78685e6683e1af4bea2ee.png[/img]
[*] [b]Added[/b] new animations for a teller. Now teller looks more realisticly, not just a ragdoll.
[*] [b]Added [/b]sleeping system, now if you want, you can use bed in your house for skipping night. 
[*] [b]Added:[/b] new background screens in main menu.
[*] [b]Changed:[/b] then the day end you will not teleported in your house. You can work all the night, but buyers still comming in your store from 8:00 till 23:00 o'clock. You will see conlusion infromation about your day, and after then you can do some work in your store.
[*] [b]Changed:[/b] the probabilities of rich buyers and limits on the quantity of money have been changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/73420619c15342b5631e0e474978a2c88f4e54ed.png[/img]
[*] [b]Fixed: [/b]  if store closed, but buyers still being in the store, they will not just dissapear with items, they will make payment and then go out of the store.
[*] [b]Fixed: [/b]  now buyers will not stuck in each other then they making an a payment. If buyers more than 1 they will make a queue for paying.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/771b1797a5a3f3200ba9ebd44db5c9664f9f7b7e.png[/img]
[*] Leadearboard has been cleared. So now you can be the best seller!
[/list]

[b]Trading cards[/b]
I'm happy to say, that trading cards now available! Now you can create the badge of our game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/e1a0b43262a5ebf5096ecab5a02748da1b2d9f97.png[/img]

[b]Information about future updates[/b]
After a half of year without any updates. I'm happy to say, that I'm back and ready for creating new games and update current game more often.
Also thanks for all players, who interested in my game. If you have any ideas or improvements for the game, leave your feedback in the comments or join our discord and stay in.

Best Regards,
DiamosDev

[url=https://discord.gg/KBKpT3jW5x][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/cb27e36afa87664b7b8ace7b6be5044c0464ac92.png[/img][/url]

Hello everyone, I'm happy to present you new update for Gamer Shop Simulator.
If you don't purchased the game before, now you have a good opportunity to purchase with [b]-60% discount[/b]! Suggestion available up to [b]8 october[/b] including.

notes.title: Update [March 2022]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/3ffaf67cde2920f58eae4508f03a05ddde635334.png[/img]
Hello, I am pleased to inform you of a major update ([b]March 2022[/b]). In this update there have been many changes affecting various parts of gameplay and optimization. I have taken your suggestions for game improvements into account and incorporated some into this update.

The next major update will be available in [b]April 2022[/b]. It will add a large number of new items for sale in the store and changes to the city.

[b]Warning:[/b] Due to major changes, it is [b]not recommended[/b] to run the previous save, please start a new game.

Let's proceed directly to the update:
[h2]Advanced settings[/h2]
Now you can customize settings of the game more deep for comfortable gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/7e3948d1f786854187b4ffabf01ded681270a734.png[/img]

[h2]Inventory system / Skills system[/h2]
Added the inventory system, to open it press [TAB]. Your backpack can be resizable, at the start you have 5 unlocked slots of 15.
If you you want place the object from inventory, you need drag and drop it in hand slot, for fast dropping objects just drag it on background

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/1bbeff8c920264c22f6ba9461cfa378f9ee3fbef.png[/img]

Through the inventory you can get access to the skills, at this moment available just 2 skills:
[list]
[*] Movement - increase your speed in walk state and sprint state;
[*] Backpack - open additional space;
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/77b9a116bf1c056582371a22afe7926578409d69.png[/img]

[h2]Dynamic prices[/h2]
Now all prices for purchasable goods changes every day, near the price you can see label which shows is the price good or bad, by pressing on this label you can see more detail information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/e19f30fa8a37db3079a0ce2fcae90b1735dc1b8b.png[/img]

[h2]Personal prices for each item[/h2]
You can change prices for all items which places in your shop, just choose the item and precc "F - Change price", then window will be opened, you can enter you own price, note if your prices will be high, no one buy this goods. 
Check the icon near input field:
[list]
[*] Color red - price over high
[*] Color orange - price higher a little bit
[*] Color green - price is normal 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/a150a106cc1bb0f16755eb1bb6f1a2e9542695c2.png[/img]

[h2]CCTV App[/h2]
New app CCTV gives you opportunity to check what if going on in your shop without leaving computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/516956e1e906ff8736846d9957e2f6eeed89b2fd.png[/img]

[h2]Bank App[/h2]
Added Bank, from this moment you can take loans or place your money on deposit and take profit after a couple days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/3515b9760d9fadefd958e91e0d3b8163bfe4cb83.png[/img]

[h2]Illumination[/h2]
Added neon illumination for each rooms in your shop, using application "Shop Painter", you can choose which color will be your illumination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/fe1188ee84f06230264f82a54673edabd624d2ef.png[/img]

[h2]Posters / Custom Posters system[/h2]
Now you can purchase posters in Supplier app, at this moment 3 variations of poster size available with 4 different textures for each variation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/e7a64818d10b3082a80cd49fb19a935712947aa4.png[/img]

Also, you can load your own image to the poster from your Computer, for this you need to purchase speacial poster "CL, CM, CS" in Supplier, when place poster on the wall and press "F" button, when follow the instractions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715037/68c532a512bce2af64b9f755bd28e2dcd76a66e9.png[/img]

[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added: New element in main menu;
[*] Added: New visual model of signboard;
[*] Added: New SFX in the city;
[*] Added: New visual improvement in computer screen;
[*] Added: New achievements and fixed some old;
[*] Reworked: Thief;
[*] Reworked: Buyers spawn system;
[*] Reworked: Notification UI elements;
[*] Reworked: Main UI elements;
[*] Reworked: Hire App;
[*] Reworked: Bills system, now bills will spawn every day, and prices decreased.
[*] Reworked: Skipping day process;
[*] Reworked: Save elements system;
[*] Removed: Hunger & Water system;
[*] Removed: Food shop;
[*] Removed: Pipes in the shop;
[/list]

Best Regards,
DiamosDev
